activities.title: Uptown Greenery at First Ward Park
activities.description: Relax in this four-acre urban sanctuary featuring interactive fountains and lush lawns framed by the city's architecture. It is a top-tier social spot for a mid-day picnic or a quiet evening reset.

activities.title: Jazz Sessions at Stage Door Theater
activities.description: Experience the intimate, soul-stirring energy of 'The Jazz Room' in the heart of the theater district. It is a premier cultural staple for those seeking high-quality musicianship and a refined night out.

activities.title: Retro Vibes at The Diamond
activities.description: Grab a burger or Southern staple at this iconic 1945 diner that remains a Plaza Midwood social anchor. Its neon signs and eclectic crowd provide a raw, authentic baseline for any neighborhood tour.

activities.title: Boutique Social at Room Service
activities.description: Check into this cocktail lounge at Camp North End for shared plates and a high-design aesthetic. It is a quintessential afternoon transition spot for those who appreciate a well-curated, social environment.

activities.title: Bike & Brew at The Spoke Easy
activities.description: Mingle at this hybrid bicycle shop and bar where the community spirit is as strong as the craft beer selection. It is a laid-back landmark that champions a healthy, mobile, and social urban lifestyle.

activities.title: Social Sips at Spindle Bar
activities.description: Perch at this central island bar within the city’s busiest food hall for high-volume people watching. It is the tactical center of the local social scene, perfect for a quick drink between market finds.

activities.title: Authentic BBQ at Midwood Smokehouse
activities.description: Tackle a plate of the city's most famous brisket in a bustling, high-energy environment. This is the culinary baseline for anyone looking to understand the intersection of Southern tradition and modern social life.

activities.title: Craft Fermentory at Trolley Barn
activities.description: Explore an industrial fermentation hall that bridges the gap between a brewery and a high-end eatery. Located right on the Rail Trail, it is the beating heart of South End’s contemporary social scene.

activities.title: Grit and Glory at Two Buck Saloon
activities.description: Finish your night at this unapologetic dive bar where the pool tables are busy and the drinks are honest. It is a raw, authentic piece of Charlotte history that values character over polish.

activities.title: Rooftop Oysters at The Waterman
activities.description: Catch the breeze and skyline views at Top of the Hill. This South End staple offers an adventurous seafood menu in a high-energy, social environment that feels like a beach escape.
activities.location: The Waterman Fish Bar, South End

activities.title: Espresso at Not Just Coffee
activities.description: Experience the precision of Charlotte’s specialty coffee scene in the heart of Uptown’s market. It’s a fast-paced, urban social hub perfect for a morning spark before exploring the city core.

activities.title: Stroll Through Independence Park
activities.description: Walk the winding paths of the city’s oldest park, recently renovated to blend historic charm with modern social spaces. It’s a serene, leafy baseline for a casual afternoon meet-up.

activities.title: Tacos & Neon at Papi Grande's
activities.description: Dive into a high-octane social dinner with coastal Mexican vibes and vibrant decor. It’s a loud, adventurous spot in LoSo that sets the tone for a big night out.

activities.title: Live Local Sets at The Gin Mill
activities.description: Get close to the stage for live acoustic acts and a bustling patio scene right on the Rail Trail. It’s a high-visibility social landmark where the energy stays peaked well into the night.

activities.title: Gaming & Tacos at El Thrifty
activities.description: Challenge friends to social games in a polished, upscale cantina setting within Optimist Hall. It’s an adventurous mix of competitive fun and high-quality cocktails in a massive industrial space.

activities.title: Sunset Sips at Sycamore Brewing
activities.description: Join the post-work rush at this massive South End anchor. The expansive beer garden and light rail proximity make it the ultimate social baseline for meeting people before the night begins.

activities.title: Precision Caffeine at Nightflyer Roastworks
activities.description: Fuel your Wednesday morning at this roastery known for its technical mastery and community focus. It’s a quiet, high-design space where the city’s creative professionals kick off their day.

activities.title: Mac & Cheese at JackBeagle's
activities.description: Cap off your Tuesday with a legendary bowl of spicy mac and cheese in the heart of NoDa. This gritty, welcoming spot is a baseline late-night sanctuary for locals and industry workers.

activities.title: Neighborhood Hang at Rhino Market
activities.description: Grab a signature sandwich and a local brew at this authentic urban bodega. It’s a social crossroads for the Wesley Heights community, perfect for a casual Wednesday afternoon transition.

activities.title: Social Gaming at Puttery
activities.description: Experience high-design indoor mini-golf paired with curated cocktails. The immersive, lounge-like atmosphere offers an adventurous social baseline for those who want activity with their drinks.

activities.title: Greater Charlotte Book Crawl
activities.description: Embark on a literary adventure across Charlotte's independent bookstores. Collect stamps in your passport for a chance to win prizes, a perfect way to explore local gems and support small businesses.

activities.title: Free Document Shredding
activities.description: Protect yourself from identity theft by bringing your sensitive documents for free shredding. A practical and important community service available at various Office Depot/Office Max locations.
activities.location: Various Office Depot / Office Max locations, Charlotte Metro

activities.title: 10th Annual Stop Food Waste Day Celebration
activities.description: Join the community at Innovation Barn to celebrate and learn about reducing food waste. This event highlights sustainable practices and community efforts towards a greener Charlotte.

activities.title: Rally Against Duke Rate Hikes
activities.description: Stand with concerned residents and advocates at the Mecklenburg County Courthouse to protest Duke Energy's proposed rate increases. The rally will feature local musicians and speakers, preceding a public testimony hearing.

activities.title: Midweek Mixtape
activities.description: Enjoy a rotating lineup of live local bands bringing fresh energy to the patio at Camp North End. It's a fantastic free outdoor concert series to unwind mid-week with diverse sounds.
activities.location: Canteen at Camp North End, North End

activities.title: Open Mic Night
activities.description: Showcase your talents or enjoy local performers at Starlight on 22nd's open mic night. A vibrant and welcoming space for comedy, music, and poetry in the Optimist Park area.

activities.title: Trivia Night at Beer Lab
activities.description: Test your general knowledge at this popular free trivia night. Gather your friends, grab a brew, and compete for bragging rights and prizes in a relaxed brewery setting.
activities.location: Beer Lab by Ghostface Brewing, Charlotte

activities.title: The Happening: Arts/Music/Dance
activities.description: Experience a collaborative arts, music, and dance event at Jackalope Jack's. This free event brings together various artistic expressions for a dynamic and engaging evening.

activities.title: Property Tax Relief Clinic
activities.description: Receive free assistance and information regarding property tax relief from the Charlotte Center for Legal Advocacy. An important community resource for those needing support.
activities.location: Charlotte Center for Legal Advocacy, Uptown

activities.title: Night Market at Pascuales' Farm
activities.description: Explore a vibrant night market featuring local vendors, farm tours, and a scavenger hunt. A family-friendly event offering unique goods and a taste of farm life.

activities.title: Doing More with Less: AI Tools
activities.description: Join Cabin Consulting for tactical AI insights, moving past the hype to build right-sized architectures and operationalize empathy. Learn to do more with less through purposeful AI adoption.

activities.title: SouthPark After 5 Concert Series
activities.description: Enjoy free live music, delicious food trucks, and refreshing drinks at Symphony Park. This outdoor concert series is a perfect way to kick off the evening with friends and family.

activities.title: Bike Night at Cabarrus Brewing
activities.description: Join fellow motorcycle enthusiasts for Bike Night at Cabarrus Brewing Company. Enjoy craft beers, good company, and admire a variety of bikes in a lively atmosphere.

activities.title: Trivia Night at Primal Brewery
activities.description: Gather your team for a fun and competitive trivia night at Primal Brewery in Belmont. Enjoy craft beers while testing your knowledge across various categories.

activities.title: BOGO Free Movies for Students
activities.description: Students can enjoy a buy-one-get-one-free ticket deal on Wednesdays at Independent Picture House. Catch a new release or an indie film for a budget-friendly night out.

activities.title: Wednesday Jazz Jam
activities.description: Immerse yourself in live jazz with The Lovell Bradford Trio and guest musicians. A suggested donation makes this an accessible way to enjoy high-quality live music in a unique venue.

activities.title: Open Shag Dancing
activities.description: Learn or practice the Carolina Shag, the state dance, at this open dancing event. A fun and energetic way to experience Southern culture and get some exercise.

activities.title: Crash Dummies Live Comedy
activities.description: Catch a live recording of the Crash Dummies podcast, featuring sharp, off-the-cuff comedy and hilarious listener call-ins. Expect an unpredictable and funny night out.
activities.location: The Comedy Zone - Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Brewhouse Yoga
activities.description: Find your zen with a unique yoga session at Sugar Creek Brewing, which includes a free beer taster after class. A perfect blend of fitness and relaxation.

activities.title: Steve Trevino Live Comedy
activities.description: Catch 'America's Favorite Husband,' comedian Steve Treviño, live at The Comedy Zone. Known for his relatable approach and hilarious observations, it's sure to be a night of big laughs.
activities.location: The Comedy Zone - Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Arm's Length: There's A Whole World... Tour
activities.description: Experience Arm's Length live on their North America tour at The Underground. This intimate venue promises an energetic rock show with supporting acts.

activities.title: SatchVai Band Ft Joe Satriani & Steve Vai
activities.description: Witness guitar legends Joe Satriani and Steve Vai, along with Animals As Leaders, perform live. This is a rare opportunity to see these iconic musicians share the stage.

activities.title: GWAR, Soulfly & King Parrot Live
activities.description: Prepare for a night of heavy metal mayhem as GWAR, Soulfly, and King Parrot take over The Fillmore. Expect theatrical costumes, intense music, and a wild crowd.
activities.location: The Fillmore Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: John Nemeth Live Jazz
activities.description: Enjoy an evening of soulful blues and jazz with the acclaimed John Nemeth at Middle C Jazz. This intimate setting is perfect for appreciating his powerful vocals and harmonica skills.

activities.title: Crash Dummies Comedy Show
activities.description: Laugh out loud with the Crash Dummies at The Comedy Zone. This popular comedy club hosts top-tier talent for a night of stand-up.

activities.title: Troy Doherty Comedy Set
activities.description: Catch a hilarious stand-up performance by Troy Doherty at Amos' Southend. Known for his relatable humor and engaging stage presence, it's a great way to unwind.

activities.title: Indie Film Night BOGO at Independent Picture House
activities.description: Take advantage of a special 'Buy One Get One Free' offer on film tickets at the Independent Picture House every Wednesday. Discover unique indie films and support local cinema.

activities.title: Greater Charlotte Book Crawl
activities.description: Embark on a literary adventure across Charlotte's independent bookstores. Collect stamps and discover new reads as part of this city-wide event.

activities.title: Charlotte Comedy City Tour
activities.description: Hop aboard for a unique comedy experience that tours Charlotte's landmarks with hilarious commentary. It's a fun way to see the city and get some laughs.

activities.title: Harvey Cummings II, Soul-Inflected Jazz
activities.description: Enjoy an evening of smooth, soul-infused jazz with Harvey Cummings II at Middle C Jazz. His captivating performance promises a sophisticated and relaxing night out.

activities.title: Drag Bingo Charlotte
activities.description: Get ready for a night of laughs, prizes, and fabulous drag performances at Drag Bingo. This popular event combines classic bingo with high-energy entertainment.

activities.title: Billie Lee Live
activities.description: Catch a live performance by Billie Lee at The Comedy Club at Duckworth's. Enjoy great music in a relaxed setting, perfect for a mid-week outing.
activities.location: The Comedy Club at Duckworth's, Uptown

activities.title: Charlotte Knights Baseball Game
activities.description: Cheer on the Charlotte Knights as they take on a rival team at Truist Field. Enjoy America's favorite pastime with classic ballpark food and a lively atmosphere.

activities.title: Queer Karaoke Night
activities.description: Sing your heart out at Petra's Bar, a beloved queer-friendly spot in Plaza Midwood. Enjoy a supportive and fun atmosphere, whether you're a seasoned performer or a first-timer.

activities.title: DIY Terrarium Workshop
activities.description: Unleash your creativity at a hands-on terrarium workshop. Learn to build and design your own miniature ecosystem to take home.

activities.title: Bruno Mars - The Romantic Tour
activities.description: Catch the global superstar Bruno Mars as he brings his 'Romantic Tour' to Charlotte. Expect a high-energy performance with all his hits, making for an unforgettable stadium experience.

activities.title: Chef's Tasting Menu: Spring Harvest
activities.description: Indulge in a meticulously crafted multi-course tasting menu featuring the freshest spring ingredients. This exclusive culinary experience offers innovative dishes and expert wine pairings.

activities.title: VIP Night at Cloud Bar by David Burke
activities.description: Experience Charlotte's skyline from the luxurious Cloud Bar with exclusive VIP access. Enjoy premium cocktails, sophisticated ambiance, and breathtaking views.
activities.location: Cloud Bar by David Burke, Uptown

activities.title: Charlotte Symphony Orchestra: Masterworks Series
activities.description: Immerse yourself in an evening of classical music with the Charlotte Symphony Orchestra's Masterworks Series. Enjoy a program featuring renowned composers and talented musicians in a grand setting.

activities.title: Exclusive Art Preview & Gala
activities.description: Attend an exclusive preview of a new art exhibition followed by a sophisticated gala. Mingle with artists and art enthusiasts while enjoying cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

activities.title: Steve Trevino Live Comedy
activities.description: Don't miss acclaimed comedian Steve Trevino as he brings his stand-up act to The Comedy Zone. Known for his hilarious takes on family life and everyday observations.

activities.title: AfterDark 2026 Gala: Gay Men's Chorus of Charlotte
activities.description: Attend the Gay Men's Chorus of Charlotte's annual AfterDark gala, a night of delicious food, open bar, auction items, and spectacular performances by the chorus. Support a great cause in style.

activities.title: Shrek The Musical
activities.description: Enjoy a whimsical evening with 'Shrek The Musical' at Ovens Auditorium. This family-friendly Broadway hit brings the beloved ogre and his fairytale friends to life on stage.

activities.title: Exclusive Wine Pairing Dinner
activities.description: Savor an exquisite multi-course dinner expertly paired with fine wines. This exclusive event offers a sophisticated culinary journey in an elegant setting.

activities.title: The Mixology Masterclass
activities.description: Elevate your cocktail game at an exclusive mixology masterclass. Learn to craft sophisticated drinks from expert bartenders in a speakeasy setting.

activities.title: Charlotte Hornets vs. TBD
activities.description: Catch the Charlotte Hornets in action at the Spectrum Center. Experience the excitement of live NBA basketball in Uptown Charlotte.

activities.title: Opera Carolina: La Traviata
activities.description: Immerse yourself in the dramatic beauty of Verdi's 'La Traviata' presented by Opera Carolina. Enjoy a world-class operatic performance at the stunning Belk Theater.

activities.title: WWE-Style Wrestling at Lenny Boy Brewery
activities.description: Catch live professional wrestling bouts in the taproom at Lenny Boy Brewing Co. This unique event combines craft beer with high-flying, body-slamming action for an unforgettable night.

activities.title: Adult Spelling Bee Championship
activities.description: Test your linguistic prowess at this competitive adult spelling bee. Expect challenging words, witty banter, and a lively atmosphere at Free Range Brewing.

activities.title: Silent Disco in Romare Bearden Park
activities.description: Dance under the stars with hundreds of others at a silent disco in Romare Bearden Park. Choose your music channel and groove to different beats through wireless headphones.

activities.title: Haunted Charlotte Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore the spooky side of Charlotte's past on a guided paranormal walking tour through the historic Fourth Ward. Hear chilling tales of ghosts and unexplained phenomena.

activities.title: Drag Brunch: Evening Edition
activities.description: Experience the fabulousness of a drag brunch, but with an evening twist! Enjoy dazzling performances, delicious food, and cocktails from Charlotte's top queens.

activities.title: Axe Throwing Tournament: Lumberjack Games
activities.description: Unleash your inner lumberjack in a competitive axe throwing tournament. Compete for bragging rights and prizes in a fun, high-energy environment.
activities.location: Bad Axe Throwing, Lower South End

activities.title: System Overlord Escape Room Grand Opening
activities.description: Be among the first to experience 'System Overlord,' a brand new immersive escape room from The Keepers of Balance. Dive into a secret society narrative with live actors and complex puzzles.
activities.location: The Keepers of Balance, South End

activities.title: Gothic Market Pop-Up
activities.description: Explore a unique pop-up market featuring gothic-inspired art, clothing, jewelry, and curiosities. Discover one-of-a-kind items from local alternative vendors.

activities.title: Midnight Cult Film Screening: Rocky Horror Picture Show
activities.description: Join a raucous midnight screening of 'The Rocky Horror Picture Show.' Dress up, shout lines, and participate in this interactive cult classic film experience.

activities.title: Zombie Apocalypse 5K Run
activities.description: Run for your life in this thrilling zombie-themed 5K race. Navigate obstacles and avoid 'zombies' in a unique fitness challenge at the US National Whitewater Center.
activities.location: US National Whitewater Center, West Charlotte

activities.title: Charlotte Burlesque Showcase
activities.description: Experience an evening of glamour, artistry, and tease at the Charlotte Burlesque Showcase. Enjoy captivating performances by talented local and regional artists.

activities.title: Psychic & Wellness Fair
activities.description: Explore the mystical and holistic at a Psychic & Wellness Fair. Get readings, browse unique artisan goods, and discover alternative wellness practices.

activities.title: Escape Room Challenge: The Heist
activities.description: Team up with friends for a thrilling escape room challenge themed around a high-stakes bank heist. Work together to solve puzzles and escape before time runs out.
